usedFor: Bexio holds companies, quotes and invoices, and MailerLite holds the email list that “Create or Update Subscriber” fills.

bestTemplate.name: “New/Updated Company” in Bexio, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Company changes keep the subscriber current, because the action creates a new subscriber or updates the existing one.

watchOut: “New Sales-Invoice” in Bexio fires on created or updated invoices, so the same invoice can run twice.
